title: Provenance-Preserving Intelligence Propagation — support sets (OR/AND), four-surface rules

source.source_reference: Shawn's explicit teaching, main chat, 2026-10-10. Filed same-evening per his standing law: his word IS the verification (Verification Law); filed immediately, not queued.

intelligence.essence: When intelligence is summarized, combined, or handed off, its uncertainty must travel with it: 'Uncertainty follows dependencies; eligibility follows independent support; authority remains with LAW.' Every derived claim carries its support set — the OR/AND structure of what it depends on — so any consumer can see exactly which evidence props it up. Four-surface rules govern the handoff: the uncertainty label, the support set, the evidence links, and the authority boundary all survive summarization. A summary that drops the 'UNDETERMINED' label and presents the claim as established is not a summary — it's a fabrication. Derived claims inherit the weakest support of their dependencies, never the strongest.

human_view.meaning: When you pass intelligence along, its doubts travel with it. Every conclusion carries the list of what it's standing on — so anyone can kick the legs and see if it falls.
human_view.why_it_matters: Kills the whisper-down-the-lane failure where 'possibly compromised' becomes 'established fact' after three summaries.

ai_view.specification: support(claim) = OR/AND tree of evidence; standing(claim) = min over dependencies. Handoff preserves the four surfaces; dropping the uncertainty label is a fabrication event.
